Frequently Asked Questions

How To Take Collagen?

Elavate's Collagen blend is very VERSATILE & CONVENIENT - you can mix it with almost anything!

Most of our customer enjoy mixing it with warm milk (which is our favourite!)

You can also mix it with water or add a serving to your morning coffee, yogurt, smoothie or shake. 

Pro tip: You can even bake it into your favourite snacks and treats!

Elavate’s collagen is designed for ease of use and can be mixed with just about anything you like!

When to take it: We recommend taking it every morning to build a consistent daily habit, but you can enjoy it any time that works for you - with or without food.

For best results: Take it consistently every day. Most customers see visible improvements after 12 weeks of daily use.  

How does Subscribe & Save work?

On the product page you can choose between Subscribe & Save and One-Time Purchase.

If you choose Subscribe & Save, you're starting a subscription. You save at least 30% on your order, and we'll automatically send your next delivery and charge your payment method on a repeating schedule until you change or cancel it.

How often you're billed and sent a delivery depends on the plan you pick:

  • 1 bag: £39 every 4 weeks
  • 3 bags: £79.50 every 12 weeks
  • 6 bags: £135 every 6 months
  • 9 bags: £175.50 every 9 months

There's no minimum term. You can skip a delivery, change your plan or cancel at any time through the portal, or by contacting us.

What is the best time of day to take Elavate?

Elavate can be taken at any time throughout the day, however we always recommend routinely taking it in the morning, so that it becomes a daily habit - this makes it easier to remember and stick with long-term.

You don't need to worry about timing it around meals. Elavate can be taken on an empty stomach or with food, whichever you prefer. The most important thing is taking it consistently every day for the best results.

How long will a bag of Elavate Last?

Each bag contains 20 to 40 servings depending on how you use it. Each full serving provides over 8 grams of Marine, Bovine & Chicken collagen protein; some of our customers add a 5 grams of collagen to coffee and or water for a collagen boost.

What does Elavate Taste like?

Elavate has a delicious rich Chocolate Flavour and it tastes best when mixed with warm milk, creating a Creamy Hot Chocolate!

We also have a delicious vanilla & unflavoured version as well!

It's completely sugar-free with no chalky texture or fishy aftertaste like other collagen products.

Unlike other collagen products, Elavate is something you'll actually look forward to drinking every day!

Can this be Used Post Menopause?

Absolutely — Elavate was designed with women like you in mind.

After menopause, it's common to experience changes in skin elasticity, joint comfort, and overall energy. Elavate’s unique blend of collagen and supportive nutrients helps address these concerns. It includes multi-collagen peptides for skin, joints, and bones, B vitamins to support energy and metabolism, hyaluronic acid for skin hydration and plumpness, and liposomal vitamin C to aid collagen absorption and support immunity.

These ingredients are especially valuable post-menopause, when the body naturally produces less collagen and nutrient absorption can become less efficient.

So, short answer? Yes. This is absolutely for you.

What if I have an Existing Medical Condition?

Collagen is a natural protein that you regularly consume when you eat meat based products. For the mast majority of people, there should be no issue taking a concentrated collagen product. However, if you have an existing medical condition, or are pregnant/breastfeeding, we would highly recommend speaking with you doctor or GP before repeated use of our Collagen Superblend.

How Does It Work?

Collagen is known as the 'GLUE' that holds your skin, joints & muscles together.

In fact, OVER 80% of your skin is Collagen!

BUT as we age past 20, our body produces LESS AND LESS of this vital protein…

We ALL naturally begin to see changes in our skin texture, hair health & joint comfort as our collagen levels begin to DEPLETE.

BUT, there is a way to PREVENT these negative effects of aging from catching up to you.

Turn to Elavate’s Multi Collagen Superblend, designed to help keep your body looking & feeling it’s very best, by keeping your collagen levels topped up.

Studies have VERIFIED the effectiveness of collagen to:

- Reduce wrinkles
- Increase skin hydration & elasticity
- Reduce joint pain & improve function
- Increase lean muscle mass
- Boost hair & nail growth
- Support gut health

Restore your bodies vitality with Elavate’s Collagen Superblend.

It’s packed with NATURAL INGREDIENTS, and designed for MAXIMUM ABSORPTION, so you can rest assured that everything you consume, is ACTUALLY being used by your body.

When taking collagen, CONSISTENCY is key.

So, based on our customers results, we recommend taking it for AT LEAST 3 months to experience the MAXIMUM benefit 

Is there any Dairy, Gluten or Soy?

No. Elavate Collagen is certified Gluten free, Dairy free, non GMO, and Soy free.

Elavate does NOT contain any major allergens besides Fish.

Please note: Elavate is NOT vegan friendly.

What does "Hydrolysed Collagen" mean?

When collagen is “Hydrolysed”, it simply means that the Collagen has been broken down into really small particles to support better absorption into the bloodstream.

This means that your body will fully reap the benefits of our Collagen blend.

Watch out for cheap Collagen products that aren't "hydrolyzed" - they are often too larger to be properly digested into your bloodstream & they simply get wasted.

Is Elavate's Collagen Grass Fed & Wild Caught?

Yes! Our Bovine Collagen is sourced from grass fed cows, across Europe and our Marine Collagen comes from wild-caught fish in pristine nordic waters, ensuring the highest quality and sustainability for our collagen blend.

Does It Support Joints & Minimise Aches?

Collagen helps maintain normal joint function as collagen is a KEY building block of cartilage. In fact, it makes up the protein in the articular cartilage which surrounds your joints - helping to keep your cartilage strong and support your bones from rubbing against each other painfully.

Collagen is also used by many elite sports athletes to aid with muscle & joint recovery after matches.

Can I use your Collagen with other supplements or medications?
